page: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-4 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8581C processor. Utilizing the x86_64 architecture, this server features 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 2 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It is configured with 31.0 GB of system memory, yielding 7.75 GB of RAM per core, and lacks local storage or bundled GPUs.

Performance benchmarks reveal strong single-core capabilities, with Geekbench single-core and text processing scores reaching top-tier classifications. Single-threaded compression and decompression tasks, such as Gzip and Bzip3, also demonstrate strong execution speeds. However, multi-core performance and memory bandwidth benchmarks, including uncached read and write operations, fall into the weaker percentiles.

The hardware profile delivers moderate efficiency for workloads requiring high memory capacity relative to compute resources, though it presents a tradeoff in multi-threaded scaling and memory throughput. This instance is suited for memory-intensive single-threaded tasks, text processing, lightweight web serving, and small-scale language model inference.
